label: Estimated Deaths
contestNote: Estimates range from 27,000 (UN direct count) to 400,000 (US envoy estimate); 90% of Khartoum deaths go unrecorded

label: People Displaced
contestNote: 9 million IDPs within Sudan + 4.4 million refugees in neighboring countries (Chad, Egypt, S. Sudan, Ethiopia); world's largest displacement crisis. Blue Nile alone: 73,000+ displaced into Ed Damazin since Eid; 4,000+ fled to Ethiopia in March from Blue Nile RSF-SPLM-N offensive.

label: Acutely Food Insecure
contestNote: 19.5 million Sudanese (2 in 5) face acute food insecurity (IPC 3+) as of mid-May 2026, per WFP/FAO/UNICEF joint report. Of these, 5 million are at emergency hunger (IPC 4) and 135,000 in catastrophic famine (IPC 5). IPC projects lean-season peak of 28.9 million (June–August 2026). Famine confirmed in El Fasher and Kadugli; 20+ additional areas at critical famine risk. UN appeal only ~20% funded.

label: Facing Starvation (IPC5)
contestNote: Two famines formally declared: El-Fasher (North Darfur) and Kadugli (South Kordofan); 20+ additional areas at critical famine risk

label: In Need of Aid
contestNote: 65% of Sudan's population in urgent need of humanitarian support as of April 22, 2026 (UN Emergency Relief Coordinator Tom Fletcher). 2026 appeal: $3B requested, only ~16% funded. World's largest humanitarian crisis.

label: Killed in Healthcare Attacks
contestNote: WHO documented 2,052 killed in 217+ healthcare attacks since April 2023. RSF drone strikes on Al-Jabalain Hospital (Apr 3, 2026) killed 10 including 7 medical staff; ongoing attacks have pushed the total above 2,052 as of April 20, 2026.

label: Refugees in Neighbors
contestNote: Primarily in Chad, Egypt, South Sudan, Ethiopia

label: Mass Graves Discovered
contestNote: Located in Gezira, Darfur, and Kordofan states

label: Sexual Violence Cases (Reported)
contestNote: MSF treated 3,396 survivors (97% women/girls) in Darfur alone Jan 2024–Nov 2025 — called 'only a fraction of the true scale.' RSF fighters consistently identified as perpetrators.

label: Aid Workers Killed
source: UN OCHA / Aid Worker Security Database

label: Civilians Killed by Drones (Jan–Apr 2026)
source: OHCHR / UN Human Rights Chief Türk, May 11, 2026
contestNote: At least 880 civilians killed and 770+ injured in drone strikes January–April 2026, per OHCHR high-alert statement issued May 11. Drone strikes accounted for over 80% of all conflict-related civilian deaths. Markets targeted 28+ times, health facilities 12+ times. Türk called on all parties and drone-supplying states to halt transfers and attacks. The Treaty of Jeddah (May 20) commits both parties to civilian protection but both sides continue drone operations.

label: Active IPC Phase 5 Famine Zones
contestNote: IPC Phase 5 famine confirmed in El Fasher (North Darfur — under RSF siege/occupation since Oct 2025) and Kadugli (South Kordofan — SAF broke RSF-SPLM-N siege for 3rd time May 20; first supply convoy since January arrived same day, collapsing food prices). 20+ additional areas at critical famine risk. 135,000 in catastrophic IPC Phase 5 starvation nationwide.

label: Cholera Cases (Khartoum, May 2026)
source: MSF / Khartoum Ministry of Health May 2026
contestNote: MSF reported 2,500 cholera cases in Khartoum in three weeks; Khartoum Ministry of Health recorded 633 cases and 24 deaths on May 23 alone. Over 1 million children at risk. Driven by near-total destruction of Khartoum water/sanitation infrastructure (80% of facilities damaged), collapsed sewage systems, and mass displacement returns. Reflects wider public health collapse: 37% of Sudan's health facilities non-functional.
